name: Cajun-Spiced Steak with Garlic Butter Broccoli & Carrots
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle Cajun seasoning on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside to rest. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat; add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add broccoli, carrots, and salt to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
